021afbbdfc87feb1bba3e95675eb2bd7a2cd1640: This section requires public network operators to offer interconnection to other operators on equal terms, protects the confidentiality of information exchanged during negotiations, and allows the regulator to support talks and review interconnection agreements.
03db095f21e8487d548d945f46a8e6239dd31d12: This provision authorizes the Austrian federal minister to suspend or restrict the operation of telecommunications facilities and electronic communications networks for reasons of public order or grounds permitted under EU treaty law, while requiring due justification, notification to the European Commission, and stating that no right to compensation arises from such orders.
043db241abe500c7a90a74f5b4e8f79d30a2433e: This section covers users' rights to be listed in, review, correct, or delete their entries from publicly accessible subscriber directories, including the right to have specific data included free of charge and the right to opt out of listing entirely without charge, along with the requirement that providers inform users of these rights.
053303e5efad40d631c21c7135f900ba7ceddb14: This section specifies which parties are authorized to inspect the central infrastructure data held by the regulatory authority, namely network providers seeking lists of reported construction work, ministerial representatives for grant administration, and court-appointed experts for verification purposes, while excluding certain designated network component information.
05ae32e06463a5a3cd930933189da5ff52e4805f: This section explains when changes to a telecommunications license require prior approval, when authorities can modify licenses in the public interest, the license holder's obligation to implement such changes at their own cost without compensation, the reassignment of frequencies when one user's needs block others, and which authority handles broadcasting licenses.
05ebc4f2a5afa5a655048233c23fb06725149e76: This section sets out the special rules for large-scale proceedings involving more than 100 participants, including public announcement by edict on the authority's website, a six-week deadline for individuals to establish their party status, and the use of electronic communication for notifications and file access.
0658b48bf7d1bf44137f02fdcc125ae8b3668cc3: This section sets out the rules requiring dominant telecom companies to provide non-discriminatory access to their networks, offering competitors the same conditions, quality, and procedures as their own services.
07069e766e459bd760044ec726817c1e6e2836b2: This section sets out which Austrian authorities are competent to carry out official acts under the Telecommunications Act 2021, covering the territorial scope of the telecom authorities, the default competence of the Telecommunications Office, specific powers of the responsible federal minister, appeals to the Federal Administrative Court, and automated issuance of official decisions.
077423bb90973e0a5cb39eae790f238766fb04e2: This section covers the rules for a one-time extension of up to ten years for frequency allocations in harmonized radio frequencies, including the decision criteria, consultation procedures, and possible adjustments to fees and conditions.
07e559b4eb333553fccf07964687247daed13ed6: This section establishes the regulatory authority as a reporting point for phone number misuse and grants it powers to order measures such as blocking numbers or prohibiting charges when significant misuse occurs.
081880a006f162a5b154b4546d358c45a2d300e8: This section enumerates the duties of Austria's Telekom-Control-Kommission, ranging from frequency allocation and market regulation to universal service funding and cross-border dispute resolution.
0acbe7f3d0f34001bc21d461a9c84ebd15580448: This section sets out how universal service providers can claim compensation for net costs that cannot be recovered despite efficient operations, including the calculation methodology, the annual application deadline, and the regulatory authority's powers to verify claims and publish results.
0b09a23d625d887ecaff1e967ee11e8faf824df2: This provision criminalizes the intentional use, disclosure, or publication of personal data obtained through professional duties or unlawfully when done to enrich oneself or a third party or to harm another person's legally protected right to confidentiality, provided the affected individual has a legitimate interest in keeping the data secret.
0b3b24cabffef002547dcc4ebaaab0e34b5ae7be: This section sets out the process for referring disputes between telecom operators or providers over access agreements or related obligations to the regulatory authority when negotiations fail within six weeks, including the authority's ability to initiate proceedings on its own.
0cc471eb765f957286bd5e7c617386257f97ec64: It describes the annual rotation of the chairmanship, quorum and voting rules, permissible meeting formats including remote participation, and the internal rules of procedure for the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee.
0ceb381dbd45928a3d40e4809f2192bd56821526: This section defines the Data Protection Authority's mandate to enforce data protection under the GDPR and Austrian law, and confirms its jurisdiction over the highest executive organs and the President of the Administrative Court.
0d6c54ac81e361acdbd4b070d62214987b2e347a: This section sets out the rules for how telecommunications providers may process customer master data, including the permitted purposes such as contract management, billing, directories, and emergency services, the mandatory identity verification required before signing a contract or recharging, and the obligation to delete this data after the contractual relationship ends.
0de7a1996f6cfce1684fe70d27124e0c3d72a37f: This section sets out the general rules for telecommunications line rights, covering access to private property for installation and maintenance, tree cutting and forest clearances, the duty to bury lines underground when a landowner objects, the creation of line rights by the regulator, and strict liability for damage caused by exercising those rights.
10829491e8b69391fba29853cfdd915f8600148a: This section requires amateur radio stations to be operated so as not to interfere with other telecommunications systems and empowers the minister to specify by regulation which amateur stations must have monitoring equipment to check technical compliance during operation.
127644ae0c7f4af3d2f5bda286c93a2d71a8dc6b: This section sets out the rules for switching between internet access service providers on the same infrastructure, covering information duties, cooperation between providers, limits on service interruption, and the requirement for the end user's explicit consent.
13181bfafa51b2b1bde7fb67b5d32303b400cd3a: This section sets out the rules for assigning special call signs for special events, including duration limits and reduced fees for club radio stations with multiple scheduled occasions.
1385e28b04cb2bceaa3857212b6fe8a8aefbb599: This section sets out the powers of the Austrian Data Protection Authority, covering its rights to demand information and inspect data processing, its confidentiality obligations, its authority to prohibit processing that creates an immediate risk, its power to impose fines, and its role in ruling on representation criteria in data protection cases.
1534d38f331b07e2c3f06ed0f963d523beee3028: This section establishes a Universal Service Fund to finance universal service costs and sets out which telecommunications providers must contribute, how their shares are calculated and reported, and how overdue payments are enforced.
15b9d5878b75ed37f95871c9931f4c3fd88b32c0: This section covers the Data Protection Council's rules of procedure, the election, term, and removal of its chair and deputy chairs, the chair's external representation of the Council, and the administrative management handled by the Federal Ministry of Justice.
160d63302570632ffbc33318d1fdbd922468d95b: This provision establishes everyone's fundamental right to the confidentiality of their personal data, sets out when and how that right may be limited, and grants rights to access, correct, and delete personal data held in automated or manual files.
1763bd32d59aae404848e087a4e36ebad0967f64: This provision requires data controllers to consult the data protection authority before processing personal data in newly created filing systems and specifies that the authority must take certain measures within six weeks, with a possible one-month extension.
1796b743e746c5f339189205d8e5d0eb62c7d74d: This provision states that masculine grammatical forms used in the law apply equally to women and men, but when referring to specific individuals the appropriate gendered form must be used.
18ca3b5b773c79c8ac5e4f105ea1c65f1d7f43ca: This section explains how Austrian regulatory bodies, competition and data protection authorities, statistical and surveying agencies, and other ministries share information, enter cooperation agreements, and provide data or assistance to support enforcement of the Telecommunications Act.
19913c520e21a46ace58a59c84a1ac1523721f38: This section requires telecommunications operators with special rights in other sectors and annual EEA revenue of at least 50 million euros to keep separate accounts or structurally separate their public communication activities, and authorizes the regulator to require independent audits of financial reports for operators not already subject to such audit requirements.
1a5e8303c7c8c1b4593c11fcbd8eb5931dc9ecf0: This section requires network providers planning or executing construction work to offer other network providers an agreement to coordinate those works upon request when high-speed network components are involved, specifies the limited grounds on which such requests may be refused, and requires that the costs of coordination be shared in an appropriate proportion.
1bf0eedf2e8ec27f2b50a7a51eba23a27c92256f: This section sets out the rules requiring telecom providers to notify the regulatory authority of their general terms and conditions and pricing before offering services, including exemptions, notice periods for changes, and the authority's right to object within six weeks if the terms violate the law.
1c3064b3210ce149af5401ce1844e407d4cb3219: This section explains what Austria can do when cross-border coordination of radio frequencies with other EU member states fails or causes interference, including asking the EU Radio Spectrum Policy Group to mediate and, if the problem continues, requesting a decision from the European Commission.
1cd2d5b76b914de96de7bdfd87a471bdd606d438: This section outlines the procedure for end users to challenge billed telecommunications charges, including the provider's obligation to verify billing factors, the deferral of payment deadlines during dispute resolution, refund and interest rules, and the use of flat-rate compensation when the exact correct amount cannot be calculated.
1d719ef22ef51799cad8509235bd467b7c58bb79: This section covers the license-free construction and operation of communication networks, the technical standards for security and interoperability they must meet, the obligation of operators to publish interface specifications, and requirements to keep emergency communication services available during network failures.
1e4c08a3aaade58db90873b41b68f4f3324ab3a5: This section describes the conciliation procedure through which end users, providers, interest groups, and funding bodies can bring disputes or complaints—covering service quality, universal service, alleged legal violations, and payment issues—to the regulatory authority, which must attempt an amicable settlement or communicate its view, while outlining the parties' duties to cooperate and the authority's ability to issue procedural guidelines.
1ee45fd9d3177b7cd83d157ff1a319dd76b854e4: This section requires a usage fee for every communication parameter, allows the responsible federal minister to set the fee amount by regulation based on costs, economic benefit, and optimal use, and applies the same fee obligation to parameters already in use or held when the law takes effect.
1f278eec522696af6b88a8f232871433fb6ece91: This section explains how to apply for and obtain permits for radio installations, which authority decides and within what deadlines, how long permits last, what conditions may be attached, and how permits can be transferred or modified, including special rules for broadcasting and cross-border interference.
1f55e0f99bfca7c1230516a9972b7d750b95b0ed: This provision establishes the data secrecy obligation requiring controllers, processors, and their employees to keep personal data confidential, and sets rules on when employees may disclose data, post-employment confidentiality duties, mandatory staff instructions, protection from retaliation for refusing unlawful disclosure orders, and safeguards preventing legal privilege from being circumvented through processors.
1f97f7986d6ac74a46b454c913857e687ea655c5: This provision defines what counts as an image recording and lays down when private video surveillance is lawful or unlawful, covering permissible purposes, specific legitimate-interest scenarios, prohibited practices, and rules for sharing the data collected.
20aeaa7d68f509514dd0059c8408df1b62ec25a4: This section specifies when and how telecommunications providers may suspend or disconnect services due to a customer's failure to pay, covering required warnings and deadlines, permissible fees, the ban on blocking emergency calls, and special protections for universal services.
20c0434ddc4cd600d45baa0e3139ddc93c792e07: This section outlines the tasks of the Data Protection Authority regarding the processing of personal data by law enforcement authorities, including supervising compliance, handling complaints, and informing the public.
20f1dc0e1acb2f39cbfb7d2ed360731ada355383: This section requires the regulatory authority to issue an ordinance establishing a plan for communication parameters—including emergency numbers such as 112 and 116000—that sets conditions for their allocation, rules for their use and transfer, and deadlines for updating existing non-compliant numbers, while obliging providers and operators to cooperate in its implementation.
21e78f3f4a51b0c1d7de5cad916fd0c25e50e5d7: This section covers the regulatory authority's powers to impose, change, or lift specific obligations on telecommunications companies with significant market power and to monitor compliance, including reviews when market developments occur.
236e87412909382c799fc8f7d6cf2a339c60a3d7: This section requires telecom providers to immediately give emergency services caller location and subscriber data during emergencies—including from unregistered mobile devices—and sets rules for technical interfaces, documentation, later notification to users, and regulatory technical standards.
2370d648a9f5968efe784970f7cfc9d058fa22de: This section describes the procedures and criteria the regulatory authority must follow when assigning radio frequencies, including competitive selection processes and public justification requirements.
24106c834f5bca97d95444c0af59a1eed2edd927: This section lists the administrative fines for telecommunications violations, ranging from €1,000 to €100,000 with possible imprisonment of up to six weeks for uncollectible fines, covering offenses such as unauthorized radio operation, amateur radio rule breaches, emergency call failures, and data protection violations.
24b19418dd93f2a1e32b50636387bfa390ad81af: This section sets out the rules for awarding earmarked grants to support the law's goals, defining grants to external entities as subsidies and grants to municipalities for building empty conduits for high-speed networks as purpose-specific grants under Austrian financial laws.
25564fb5c143483950d02e5784b6f338fff20728: This section covers the requirement that landowners tolerate the use of legally secured lines or facilities on their property for establishing, operating, expanding, or renewing communication lines when the property's intended use is not permanently further restricted, and the landowner's entitlement to a one-time compensation set by the regulatory authority.
27ec925abc18ccb4d5ba53e18554fa11ca570c1e: This section grants individuals the right to claim compensation for material or immaterial damage caused by violations of the GDPR or this Act, and specifies which regional court has jurisdiction over such claims.
28396c14f106dc28833846eed945c4ad4dd5adca: This section sets out the subjects covered by the amateur radio exam, allows the written parts to be automated or multiple-choice, empowers the minister to define exam categories and procedures by regulation, and permits holders of a lower-category certificate to sit a supplementary exam for a higher category.
28f339e7762a2b66353de9595ac522b7658d3230: This section establishes an examination commission at the telecommunications office, consisting of two members appointed by the minister for five years—a legal expert from the authority who chairs the commission and an experienced amateur radio operator for operations and technology—and provides that the chair has the deciding vote in the event of a tie.
293aeb6f9e9f4a4127653fff0f95ff2ec112b9e5: This section requires that rights under sections 51 to 70 be exercised in the least intrusive way possible, with maximum care for the affected properties, facilities, and third-party rights, while ensuring continued proper use during any works and prompt restoration of the site to a proper condition afterward.
29a05820175670c99e92ef61430e37ff19dfbea3: This section sets maximum charges for terminating voice calls on mobile and fixed networks, including EU-wide caps, rules for national regulators when no EU cap exists, and requirements for monitoring and annual reporting to EU authorities.
2a1e950c19ba5530c7b1cb7392c116c180f6287e: This section sets out the rules for how the regulatory authority may numerically limit frequency allocations and attach conditions to ensure competition, including requirements for public consultation, written justification, publication, and periodic review or revocation of such limits.
2a469964fe70385f7e91eca65d39b9a9670d04a7: This section sets out rules requiring data controllers to establish confidential whistleblowing procedures for reporting data protection violations, including protections for both the reporting person and the accused, and references related reporting and mutual assistance duties.
2a7048b94c38b388816b656f2d94e47c2d623059: This section requires holders of rights to certain infrastructures to allow public communication network providers to co-use communication-capable facilities when economically reasonable and technically feasible, and empowers the regulator to mandate such co-use for environmental, health, safety, or urban planning reasons.
2aa98e1159b1f6308ac41d1fd4f58dd26af9cd57: This section sets out the rules for when the regulator can change telecommunications plans, how affected license holders must be notified, the safeguards for existing rights and costs, and the requirement that license holders pay for and implement the changes themselves.
2ad45980c3828a1e8822fb22aeabd09626c8df95: This section sets out the procedural rules for proceedings before the Austrian telecom regulators, covering dispute-resolution referrals to the RTR-GmbH, mandatory electronic filing, domestic service addresses for non-EEA providers, decision deadlines and cooperation duties, a ban on new evidence after the investigation closes, and appeals to the Federal Administrative Court.
2addc4d5fb534901cc45e7f87841bc32f06d251e: This section states that when this federal law refers to provisions in other federal laws, those provisions apply in their currently valid version.
2c7c076edf94728207c27e378627c4b1a06eba65: This section covers the right of network providers to lay lines on public property free of charge and without a separate permit, subject to written notification to the administrator and exceptions for certain costs, with disputes referred to the regulatory authority.
2db7764f638101f5a0c93b619564461a1deaaf13: This section assigns the general regulatory duties under the Telecommunications Act to RTR GmbH, designates it as the national regulatory authority under certain EU regulations, and grants independence to its managing director for telecommunications and postal matters in specific cases.
2e5ca59d48433800f839141aef4dc2200adc40b8: Network operators must disable third-party-initiated automatic call forwarding to a user's device upon request and free of charge, cooperating with other operators when multiple are involved in the forwarding.
2eea7ddc77fc6b92735529e85611cbe9dd7327eb: This section requires the regulatory authority to share information with the European Commission and with BEREC or other national regulators upon their justified written request, and to notify operators when their data is sent to the Commission.
307714a1b434706e56c0f629cbbb3b7eb41ca108: This section describes how public communication network providers and emergency services can request co-use of telecommunications infrastructure, the obligation of infrastructure owners to submit offers upon written request, the four-week period for reaching an agreement before either party can apply to the regulatory authority for a decision, and the requirement for mobile operators to establish framework agreements for sharing antenna masts.
32e86afa78bb333e88f7aed76356697b4be1239b: This section states that allocation of communication parameters grants only a right to use them rather than any right to specific parameters, and that using parameters without a proper right of use is not permitted.
348fbea131665b094473d7b9bdf7055e2b17be6b: This section designates the Austrian federal ministers responsible for enforcing specific provisions of the Telecommunications Act 2021, including cases where multiple ministries must agree.
3523f24a9c4ec8234510629379c2573b67e627b7: This section governs how individuals can file a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority regarding alleged violations of data protection law, including the required contents of the complaint, filing deadlines, the authority's handling and decision-making process, and the right to appeal to the Federal Administrative Court if the authority does not respond.
3560f8b5fe1105d8bb3fcea133e7f2830903494d: This section outlines the purpose, objectives, and guiding principles of Austria's 2021 Telecommunications Act, identifies the EU laws it implements, and notes that it also regulates amateur radio.
35c00861db2d4482223426055b0500b714072b26: This section outlines the scope of an amateur radio license, covering permitted station types and locations, transmission restrictions, and special rights for Class 1 holders.
36a7efb990d9f114067a9286d5ce1e7a62ba9394: This section designates the head of the Data Protection Authority as the joint representative in the European Data Protection Board and the central contact point.
3760319c48fb334fc477d1d55dd12fab84760c43: This section outlines the information that data controllers must provide to individuals about the processing of their personal data, when that information must be given, and the specific grounds on which the additional details may be delayed or withheld.
3864179d236d76a82c14659e56b5605b7f287092: This section governs how radio frequencies are allocated, including the criteria and procedures, allowed restrictions on technology and service neutrality, the authorities responsible for different types of frequencies, deadlines, and conditions for individual assignments.
3a458afc5631e438135daa8f1ad29fffbe2f2450: This section empowers the telecommunications regulator to issue ordinances setting rules on charges, billing transparency, and consumer protection for third-party services provided via special number ranges, and requires the regulator to maintain and publish a directory of the providers of those number-bound services.
3bded4c91fe42064955e4a6b8a47c81222ec8cb9: This section sets out the application requirements, decision process, and ongoing reporting duties for obtaining and holding an amateur radio license in Austria, including rules for call signs, delivery agents, and duplicate licenses.
3c7bf4bd80b81002650a0630d82cb028a6d92982: This section states that rights under sections 51 to 70 transfer automatically with their obligations to the owners or users of the communication infrastructure, are enforceable against any possessor of the affected property, are not recorded in the land register and do not create prescriptive rights, and may be assigned by public network providers to third parties for the construction, maintenance, and expansion of the network.
3cdd9b20765a88f92b8fd3147b20cd3a4acf4a5d: This section requires the telecommunications regulator to offer a free, independent tool for end users to compare prices and service quality of internet and communication services, sets mandatory standards for such comparison tools, and permits third parties to use published provider data to create their own comparators.
3d795073fd838488b0dd58ddf44b3e9629d9e9b3: This section establishes the Telekom-Control-Kommission to perform the tasks in § 198, locates it at the Rundfunk und Telekom Regulierungs-GmbH, and confirms that its members are independent and not bound by instructions.
3e63936301c484e75abfebeafea87f30e79df97a: This section sets out the required data-security measures for transmitting operationally necessary traffic and location data to legally authorized authorities, including a central transit point, transport encryption, end-to-end content encryption, and advanced electronic signatures.
411dd41bbdf6d934ec9575dd0e9c78a3ffbe5913: This section requires data controllers and processors to maintain detailed records of their personal data processing activities, specifying required entries such as profiling usage, legal bases, international transfers, and technical security measures.
41a4e13f0a33b4cf8b291fe4119421cd6b84fee1: This section requires owners of high-speed-capable in-building physical infrastructure to allow public network providers to share that infrastructure for communication lines up to the first concentration or distribution point when this is economically reasonable and technically feasible and building a duplicate would be inefficient or impossible.
41c8743632b275f435e24d2ca3a3d0d781bfe467: This section sets out where regulations and official announcements from the Federal Minister and the regulatory authority must be published, including the Federal Law Gazette II and the authority's website, and how technical documents may be made available for inspection during office hours.
42b387a5f074835963a514fed7a70e446c5f157c: This section limits telecom operators' processing of master, traffic, location and content data to what the communication service requires, requires revocable consent for marketing or value-added services, obliges providers to tell users which personal data they process, on what legal basis and for how long, and allows storing or accessing information on a user's terminal equipment only with the user's consent, except where this is needed solely to transmit a message or to provide a service the user explicitly asked for.
43db4c3a6e3a5ee79447f9c7195dd3d1f177f9ef: This provision requires data controllers and processors to cooperate with the data protection authority upon request when it is carrying out its tasks.
441b0d509d6cdf779dffb28e9441982d48366ff9: This section requires telecom companies with significant market power to notify the regulator in advance before decommissioning or replacing network infrastructure and sets out when the regulator may lift specific obligations once suitable migration conditions are met.
4597891691af895475fd26967423fbb4793764b5: This section covers the requirement to submit agreements to the regulatory authority on request, the duty of all parties to facilitate the use of rights under this part, and the authority's option to publish model contract terms on its website.
45b8af12693bb7f6ff8bd8050be0cafa1e6728e5: This section specifies that inquiries about coordinating construction work must be submitted in writing with detailed project information and that either party may apply to the regulatory authority for a decision if no agreement is reached within one month.
45e2b8a82b6dea3ed4e1b5fc254277511b2eb761: This section outlines the procedural rules for regulatory proceedings under sections 87 to 89, covering who qualifies as a party, the right of competition authorities to comment, public notice requirements for hearings, and duties to publish decisions and notify the European Commission of significant market power designations and imposed obligations.
4724d22d7d3f2761136197fc10ebbfb42f0c94a5: This section requires the regulatory authority to publish and keep current on its website general information about the conditions and procedures for obtaining permits for construction work needed to build components of high-speed electronic communication networks, including any exemptions from permit requirements.
479164595a8e8ff1700f0ea0987ec2aa311fa871: This section defines what a telecommunications line easement covers—such as building and maintaining lines, running cables through buildings, installing small antennas, and clearing trees—and states that its specific terms come from an agreement or a decision by the regulatory authority.
49720d0c50c99f5957b44d9d71acb3260683d1b3: This section requires that a party burdened by a co-use right under sections 60 to 64 receive appropriate compensation covering the costs of constructing, acquiring, and operating the shared facility and other related expenses, determined with reference to market rates and average values.
49f285ad38e81d6d79baba1aaf86c73e5c2f753a: This section covers cybersecurity obligations for telecommunications operators and providers, the regulator's authority to issue detailed technical security requirements and require non-EU companies to designate a domestic address for legal service, specific biennial risk analysis and security planning tasks assigned to the RTR, and special procedures for broadcasting networks.
49f8d36fd7de7a30822787cc31b9455184cfe75d: This section sets out the circumstances under which a telecommunications authorization ends, the grounds on which the authority may revoke it, that revocation gives no right to compensation, and that an amateur radio license certificate must be returned within two months after the license expires.
4a9edbc662fa0815121822dc6db65ab7d9b03ad9: This section allows the telecommunications regulatory authority to request that the Cartel Court order a company to disgorge economic advantages gained from violating telecom laws, up to 10% of the company's previous year's turnover, with the funds going to finance the regulatory body.
4c50db05d272ab67e48130adaac39aecd967d90c: This section states that being allocated frequency usage rights grants only the right to use specific frequencies, not ownership or property rights over them.
4c8018b1ed56350ac88ae68959c6f9b06998718f: This section sets out how telecom companies with significant market power can offer commitments to the regulator on cooperation, co-investment in very high capacity networks, and network access, and the conditions under which the regulator can make these commitments binding and monitor compliance.
4cdc6a679578334170e6e58fc1fe2b73aa1925b5: This section sets out the rules for when telecommunications providers may store, process, delete, or disclose traffic data, including requirements for billing, limits on internal use, and permitted disclosures to courts, prosecutors, and security authorities.
4d9c08f1aa9b3e974f36dcc89009f0536355057b: This section specifies that KommAustria, rather than the general telecommunications regulator, handles regulatory matters involving electronic audio and audiovisual media, broadcasting, additional services, and video-sharing platforms, and lists the specific powers it exercises in those cases along with rules for overlapping jurisdiction and appeals.
4de7d539bb80651963888d0975197717ab3d244e: This section outlines the composition, appointment procedures, eligibility requirements, terms of office, and compensation for members of the Austrian Data Protection Council.
4f42618c7804e0b5785a0225e65972be369bada4: This provision sets out the tasks of the Austrian Data Protection Authority, including advising government bodies on data protection legislation, publishing certain GDPR lists and criteria, and acting as the national accreditation body.
4fc81b503102df522f8b882e2f017782580d4540: This section sets out when the telecommunications regulatory authority must examine suspected cartel law violations and file applications with the Cartel Court, including a mandatory duty to apply when cartel prohibitions are breached and the purposes of the Telecommunications Act are affected.
507e7af5a0f4813287853a29a6703dcb98277533: This section sets out when and how land may be expropriated to build communication lines, including the public-interest test, the requirement to use the least intrusive means, rules for compensating owners or taking full ownership when a partial taking makes the property unusable, and the procedural laws that apply.
510d13b8264ee1eacd179e17b82d6eabe0230243: This section covers the rules on fees for transferring a phone number to another provider, including that the end user cannot be charged for the transfer itself and that prepaid providers must refund any remaining credit, with any fee for that refund only permitted if specified in the contract and proportionate to the actual costs incurred.
518e862a3b03c2822440b1d4dc2395fee31a9924: This section states that when an internet access contract ends, the end user can demand that the provider continue forwarding emails to their provider-branded email address free of charge for twelve months, and that the regulatory authority may issue regulations specifying the technical details of how this forwarding process should work.
51b4c6c60ae4b26b769a54caa0d259e55f9bca2e: This section sets out the rules for number portability, requiring telecom providers to let customers switch operators while keeping their existing phone number, and covering the transfer process, timing limits, service continuity, return of numbers not ported after a contract ends, and the regulator's power to set technical details and compensation rules.
52d3d76023bfe0bfcb31141d2f029dbb781333f6: This section requires the holder of an amateur radio station to take appropriate measures to prevent unauthorized persons from putting the station into operation.
5334a0f7b7261ab674a72ab5fc5b9a3ab142a179: This section allows public network operators to demand that end users remove interfering or non-compliant radio and terminal equipment from the network termination point, and prohibits operators from refusing to connect terminal equipment that meets the essential requirements of the ETG 1992.
57c5f5fdc338c72c2d0d1694eadc95d9b3efb6e4: This section requires providers of voice calls and number-based text messages to ensure their users can communicate with users of all other such services, guarantees access to international and non-geographic numbers, and gives the regulator power to order large messaging services to interoperate when end-to-end connectivity is threatened.
57fd9e789262fbc43bc34c57021b0e99153f5351: This section sets out the dates on which various provisions of the Austrian Data Protection Act and related ordinances entered into force or expired under different amending laws from 2000 through 2025.
586dca8fbf425a398dedadeb133ab2abbfe3c0e9: This provision governs how providers of public communication networks can acquire rights to establish and operate antenna sites on land owned by public authorities, including the conditions for such use, compensation payable to the owner, and the procedure for resolving disputes when no agreement is reached.
5bfee0529be2ed2474cf75f0e8e3ad7bdb0d0439: This section contains transitional rules for the shift from the old Data Protection Act 2000 to the new law and GDPR, covering ongoing terms, pending cases, the legacy data register, prior approvals, and the transfer of powers to new oversight bodies.
5d957d5eab86cdddfa383af5d6d0a14192f309bd: This provision authorizes the regulator to require dominant telecom companies to keep separate books for access services, disclose wholesale and internal transfer prices in a prescribed format, and provide detailed cost accounting documents that may be published to support competition.
5dfff93b5bd583b092767f596ec759f835bd973e: This section covers the conditions under which the regulatory authority can require telecom companies with significant market power to set cost-based access prices, the obligation on those companies to justify their pricing, and the regulator's oversight of their cost accounting methods.
5eddf1ff64f3ee0ae60a505c0f841511c1a7e653: This section sets out when providers of public communication networks may use private land for lines, the compensation owed to owners, the required written notification and offer process, and the option for either party to request a regulatory authority decision if no agreement is reached within four weeks.
6006981398e807f1c891357b227e7777709e6f91: This section sets out the duties of telecom operators, providers, and spectrum holders to hand over information to regulators and law enforcement for compliance, market statistics, and criminal investigations, and mandates record-keeping of cell tower locations and notification of low-power wireless access points.
6077ada72f4a6cd5e0622c6da9b5c82df06c8999: This section describes the procedure for complaints to the Federal Administrative Court against decisions of the Data Protection Authority, including the composition and qualifications of the deciding senate, the sharing of case documents with its members, and the forwarding of European Data Protection Board opinions.
611361faf572bf1c3737e10b3a5533ccb68fb5f0: This section sets out common rules for sharing telecommunications facilities, covering how existing infrastructure and future technical needs must be considered, when property owners must allow sharing and receive compensation, and the regulator's power to order sharing of existing communication lines.
61960f3d89134db381276757dbfdaa7e94f510a6: This section defines when a company is considered to have significant market power and when that status can extend to related neighboring markets.
64371b4fbe87073bba1ae6e8e7ed3965bda00e11: This section sets out the procedure for defining relevant telecommunications markets, analyzing whether firms hold significant market power, and imposing or adjusting regulatory obligations, including deadlines for periodic market reviews.
65b5def54e7d6aaf38c008ed61f9842e78d196a2: This section states that everyone is entitled to use communication services under published terms and prices and prohibits providers from applying different access or usage conditions based on a user's nationality, residence, or place of establishment unless such differences are objectively justified.
66145bddba376e71bdf6c22121e83bdb1244f2a6: This provision states that the Austrian Data Protection Act serves to implement the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and to transpose the EU Law Enforcement Directive on processing personal data by competent authorities for criminal justice purposes.
6689f723d5326e0e23e00c8924853612c106d401: This section sets out the duty of public security organs to assist the telecommunications office in carrying out surveillance measures and states that telecommunications authorities enforce their own non-monetary orders under administrative enforcement law.
66addad27ec6db67b097ecef45b39bf53ba8547f: This section sets out the peer review procedure requiring the national regulatory authority to inform the Radio Spectrum Policy Group about draft spectrum award measures for harmonized frequencies and, if requested, to convene a peer review forum where it explains how the draft meets EU objectives, with the Group able to provide a report or opinion.
66df7f786557ea6fb4b7ee639f5e1fd1c290436b: This section covers the rules for importing, distributing, and possessing radio equipment, which is generally permit-free except for certain devices reserved for public security and defense authorities, and sets out when the minister may require permits for radio transmitting equipment and the conditions for granting them.
67558b3995615ac6608c410b895a20b4c9bc2aef: This section authorizes the regulatory authority to monitor competition in the electronic communications sector using publicly available or provided data and to publish related information or studies.
69dbe66cb652ea482839f7b0656cd119ff3dafea: This provision defines when the GDPR and Austrian data protection law apply to data processing and establishes specific rules for handling criminal records, obtaining children's consent for online services, and limiting the right of access to protect public duties and trade secrets.
6a6eae3f87067988cf0859da48407c67817a4fcd: This provision requires the Austrian Data Protection Authority to cooperate with the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee on EU matters to ensure consistent GDPR application and to inform and involve the committee in all matters concerning the European Data Protection Board.
6c6a63f452c30e3c9d38727a11db0f3775a1b44f: This section permits ordinances implementing this law to be issued the day after the law is published but prohibits them from taking effect before the law itself does.
6d6c0c4b5de3001a60e9c9081e37a6d5827df451: It explains the rules for sharing people's address data so they can be notified or surveyed, covering when consent is needed, when it is not, and when the data protection authority must approve the sharing.
6d7c65790143b6898f055839d61c58649a6fa76d: This section outlines the mandatory logging of data processing activities, the specific details that must be recorded in automated and non-automated systems, and the restricted purposes for which the logs may be used.
6dcb53ee86db1a3e2e253f769698e2b5aa2dd134: This section defines which entities count as public-sector data controllers under Austrian law and describes their procedural rights in proceedings before the Data Protection Authority and administrative courts.
6f1608333c4f37fcd343c9017d52a717ebfdb171: This section specifies the conditions under which special categories of personal data—such as health, biometric, genetic, or information revealing racial origin, religion, political views, or sexual orientation—may be processed for the purposes listed in § 36(1), requiring strict necessity, protective safeguards, and either permission under § 38 or that the person has clearly made the data public themselves.
70c90337ab320695f11bc90a99485533bf2b0f9a: This provision establishes the independence of Austria's Data Protection Authority and its head, including restrictions on outside activities that could compromise impartiality and limits on ministerial oversight to ensure the authority's autonomy under the GDPR.
70db1efdff92e75e901321aa3b1137330f992a35: This section states that the data protection authority will apply the GDPR fine criteria proportionally and will generally issue warnings for first-time violations.
71e38d765ec246d33bf5b35bf04fbdd4a96f8023: This section sets technical, safety, and environmental requirements for radio and terminal equipment, authorizes the minister to issue detailed technical regulations, and mandates that new passenger cars include receivers capable of digital terrestrial radio.
74f3c47ef3ea379114b4c2d4abaff4a02a2f21d3: This section sets out the legal framework for agreements between mobile network operators to jointly use or access active network components, covering notification requirements, regulatory approval procedures, and the invalidity of non-compliant agreements.
7519d8880ea862ad24d807eb236a9a13b0b5600b: This section defines emergency and disaster radio communications, outlines amateur radio operators' obligations to assist authorities during emergencies, and specifies procedures for emergency calls and drills.
76ce434e6229da15a87df01a837e610c3038c51b: This section authorizes the regulatory authority to issue ordinances specifying the detailed modalities for providing and accessing infrastructure data and to grant exemptions from these obligations for certain infrastructures and minor construction projects.
79b3a1dd0e1f9b93f5d2c1ad585c8d99431c6f74: This section sets out the supervisory procedure the regulator follows when it has indications that a company is violating telecommunications law, including notifying the company and giving it a chance to respond or fix the issue, ordering corrective measures if the issue persists, suspending or banning the company's operations for gross or repeated violations, taking emergency action in cases of immediate danger, and defining who qualifies as a party in the proceedings.
79e8f2dff5eaf63e04358ac0f3c5a1b10aac9e68: This section sets out the rules for publishing a call sign list that includes amateur radio operators' names, station locations, call signs, and license classes, requires consent for personal data, and limits use of the data to amateur radio purposes only.
7ba677cbe105fed569ef9eab0598844def809bb7: This section requires the regulatory authority to establish and maintain a central database of telecommunications infrastructure data, obliging network providers to report details about existing physical infrastructure and planned construction works—including locations, types, and timelines—and to keep this information updated.
7bd35993cb0283a07ad06bf47da98a61196757fd: This section governs how telecom providers must issue bills and itemized connection statements for internet access and number-based communication services, covering the required details and chronological listing, the option to receive paper copies, electronic delivery and seven-year retention rules, limits on displaying dialed numbers and excluding free or emergency calls, and the deadlines for deleting the underlying data.
7c15b1f50dc06f5d0b93c9b16a21f84a67e73486: This section lists the ways a telecommunications allocation can end—such as expiry, waiver, revocation, or the holder's death—and specifies the grounds for revocation and the written procedure for waiver.
7c3eb13ede51c333bc809ccea2586c7b88e0615a: This section enables the Federal Minister for Agriculture, Regions and Tourism to recognize foreign certificates by ordinance, provided that reciprocity exists and the foreign training is equivalent.
7c5dc87ed5201d2e50e46e409ce71ebf514080be: This section sets out the conditions, procedures, and obligations for changing frequency allocations, including when the authority may alter them, notice and comment requirements, the definition of minor changes, and the allocation holder's duty to comply at their own cost.
7d8d37143a2ab0e0e886f7e61fa6152d74b49c5a: This section defines the duties of the Artificial Intelligence Service Center within the telecommunications regulator, covering public advisory services on AI regulation, technical documentation, knowledge exchange, cybersecurity, and high-risk AI systems, plus coordination roles and required consultation with the media division on media-related AI issues.
7e406369c94603118c4123d0894ac95411c70a04: This section covers the rules for bundled service packages containing internet access or number-based communication services, including extended consumer protections for all bundle components, the right to terminate the entire bundle if individual parts are breached, prohibitions on extending contract terms when adding extra services, and application to small businesses and non-profits unless waived.
7e6ec9163d1e17aca704459b841d4782d76c62cb: This section governs when and how location data other than traffic data may be processed, requiring anonymization or revocable user consent and limiting use to what is strictly necessary for the service.
7f03fc9390816a3048a01aff8b7dc63076b79c54: This provision governs automated individual decision-making, including profiling, by allowing it only when legally authorized, requiring protective measures for sensitive data, and banning discriminatory outcomes based on characteristics like race, religion, health, or sexual orientation.
7ff2a15e3b3a301a62d17371f4da692bf7e21e2f: This section requires data controllers and processors to implement technical and organizational security measures appropriate to the risk of processing personal data, and lists ten specific controls for automated processing systems.
807a15928187701c1f862f80725eb0e97c977211: This section sets out the principles for managing and allocating radio frequencies in Austria, requiring objective, transparent, non-discriminatory criteria and EU harmonization, promoting broadband coverage, new technologies, spectrum sharing, interference prevention and health protection, and assigning broadcasting-frequency tasks to KommAustria.
826df59be8f571c24da12a02872286cfe7adecd6: This provision describes the accompanying measures available to the Austrian Data Protection Authority in complaint proceedings, such as protecting the complainant's confidentiality interests, ordering disputed data to be marked, reviewing and enforcing disclosure when a controller invokes Article 23 GDPR restrictions, and revoking approvals for cross-border data transfers when the underlying conditions cease to exist.
8376e8d0591c13c2803436791d1fc95121bce9d4: This section requires the telecommunications regulator to collect quarterly geographic data on current and planned broadband coverage from network operators, share it with the minister for agriculture, regions and tourism for public mapping and funding decisions, and provide it to end users, including a process for flagging areas where no high-speed network build-out is planned within three years.
8380d6789f317d36370cce3cf71ef340de448671: This section sets out that property owners retain the right to use and modify their land despite telecom installations on it, but must notify the operator before work that could affect those installations, and it covers liability for damages, regulatory dispute resolution, and information duties for agricultural land.
83d81e267756a1e23b6cb655b4cae8ce013c15ea: This section states that an amateur radio examination certificate is issued upon application to applicants who demonstrate their professional qualification by successfully passing the amateur radio examination.
87039f4c7edce9563ff5043e9634bc83775c2b22: This provision requires the Austrian Data Protection Authority to prepare and distribute an annual activity report to government bodies and the public, and to publish its decisions of fundamental importance.
890cc7ee578ddc0e47b6acaafe18a80360469ed2: This section authorizes telecommunications authorities to order or, in urgent cases, conduct searches of property, homes, persons, and vehicles when an unauthorized radio transmitter endangers people or property or international obligations require it, prescribes how such searches must be carried out with proportionality and care, and requires a brief written record to be given or left with the person searched.
898f89fd4002608b3636ec7c7cc90e002d0b346d: This section outlines the authorities responsible for supervising communication services and telecommunications installations, defines what counts as a telecommunications installation, and details their powers to inspect equipment, enter premises, and demand information and documents from operators.
89d2593d06ae48a07261ee50723989eee22d30a1: This section sets out the procedure for designating manufacturers and service providers of electronic communications network components as high-risk suppliers for national security reasons, including the criteria for assessment, the role of an expert advisory board, and the scope of possible restrictions.
8b0b1ca1c4a4e4217a051b3f436e7f722f1f3450: This section states that the Telecommunications Act 2003 is repealed when the 2021 Act comes into force.
8b39038829272f98262650f90d2d07f36a425915: This section covers the obligations of internet and communication service providers to publish information about service quality and accessibility measures for people with disabilities, and the regulatory authority's powers to set detailed rules, verify the published information, and provide tools for end users to check it.
8c28885226f9955b868680e46161d9fe35fed085: This section specifies the conditions under which competent authorities may transfer personal data to third countries or international organizations, including requirements for purpose limitation, prior approvals, adequacy decisions or appropriate safeguards, and restrictions on onward transfers.
8c64bb1dbcdf631e76e9a6e3ef9221d546f2a450: This section defines the key terms used throughout the Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021, including communication networks, services, users, operators, emergency calls, and related infrastructure.
8d0f6339f1dab2dc7917e66f4cd27553ac969283: This section sets out when the telecommunications regulator may require a vertically integrated company with significant market power to functionally separate its wholesale access operations into an independently operating business unit that treats all competitors equally, and the procedure for obtaining European Commission approval for such a measure, including the required analyses and details of the proposed separation.
8de8b61b6da4e267e5fe6f19eb93ec42c9805059: This section sets out the transitional rules for moving from the previous telecommunications law to the 2021 Act, covering pending proceedings, existing licenses and agreements, amateur radio authorizations, and deadlines for new obligations.
8e2c3855d94b77d07737ca4e0771cb03c84e70aa: This section assigns responsibility for the transit point's setup, operation, certificate management and data security to the Federal Minister for Agriculture, Regions and Tourism, delegates the actual execution to the Federal Computing Centre GmbH as a data processor, and allows the Minister to engage a service provider to audit the technical implementation.
8eb33808520184f265bdda8321e67a0ae5fe54b9: This section requires data controllers to notify affected individuals about personal data breaches in accordance with GDPR Article 34, and allows that notification to be postponed, restricted, or omitted under the conditions set out in § 43(4).
8eb6fe51feaf5ef4358f22520b4a941ddd383d4c: This section covers the appointment, legal status, and tasks of the data protection officer, as well as the requirement to publish their contact details and notify the data protection authority.
8efc6d12d815528e9e2c749abe04314fe64cde94: This section states that all job titles and personal terms used throughout the Telecommunications Act 2021 are to be read as gender-neutral.
8f6403c141c1780652d9893ce42a74eb942780af: This provision states that an application for an amateur radio examination certificate is considered withdrawn if the applicant misses the scheduled exam without proving no fault, withdraws during the exam, or fails the exam.
90c1688e4e567c97ef8efafe5c4b64d69ac6f733: This article specifies the legal requirements for transferring personal data to non-EU countries or international organizations, covering adequacy decisions, appropriate safeguards, and narrow exceptions.
9287e178d5db084615377831edba57d8391fd6e1: This section gives individuals the right to file a complaint with the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee if they believe their personal data is being processed in violation of the GDPR or specific provisions of the Austrian Data Protection Act, and it states that certain other procedural rules apply accordingly.
93aa600399718348952d9a08b346de88015da70f: This section sets out the regulatory authority's role in allocating and managing communication parameters such as telephone numbers, including the application process, conditions attached to allocations, and the rules for transferring or passing on usage rights.
93b598abeed4a1cf8e30354daad12899fcdec139: This section outlines the telecommunications authority's powers to order measures against interference, shut down unauthorized installations, permit disconnection of harmful certified equipment, and allow emergency disconnections by network operators under specific conditions.
942d3421d50ce1296d983436ae37245fd18c8eb8: This section outlines the specific regulatory obligations that can be imposed on telecommunications companies with significant market power in end-user markets, including prohibitions on excessive or predatory pricing, barriers to market entry, and unfair bundling, as well as price cap measures and mandatory cost accounting systems.
946cb5f3d3ff18397dbe0ff3db55d0510cd3b8fc: This section requires prior regulatory approval for the transfer of frequency usage rights and for significant changes in the ownership structure of companies holding such rights, including assessments of technical and competitive impacts.
95e3038ccc0f41503c2daae38e2227a481dcf613: This section explains how providers of public communication networks can obtain minimum information about existing infrastructures from a central authority or directly from infrastructure owners in order to check whether co-use is possible, including deadlines, when access can be refused, and how disputes are resolved.
9666cb9e25b0e79d1db2e17e018935d432a96a78: This section establishes a person's right to ask a data controller whether their personal data is being processed and to receive a copy of that data along with specific details about the processing, while also setting out when this right can be restricted and how any refusal must be communicated and documented.
96b1c7ad600bece6a8d8a20cf33178ebb258bcef: This section requires telecommunications providers, payphone operators, and network operators to maintain backup equipment ensuring emergency calls connect during network outages, authorizes the regulator to set technical standards for such resilience, mandates annual functionality checks and reporting, and requires immediate notification of security incidents significantly affecting emergency number reachability.
97f21ff689ebecabcba47fa260785daf0570f9bc: This section describes how the regulatory authority assigns limited radio frequencies, covering the award criteria (including auctions based on the highest fee), public tender and application requirements, procedural rules, possible conditions attached to the assignment, and when the procedure can be cancelled or decided temporarily.
99cb75b8ec1aeda74e44094961b239818e56b70b: This section requires data controllers to report personal data breaches to the data protection authority and to promptly share breach details with controllers in other EU member states when their data is affected.
9c22521ee12f00d9a976cdb6952ae0680297ce6e: This section sets out the fees for telecommunications administrative acts like frequency allocations and certificates, covering when they become due, how they are calculated and inflation-adjusted, and how arrears are recovered.
9efcb9951d493f47a287e918b12c18858c9bf013: This section sets out the basic structure of the secure electronic clearinghouse through which telecommunications providers must handle certain data inquiries, specifying encryption and authentication requirements, preventing the data processor from accessing personal content, requiring audit-proof statistical recording, listing exceptions for urgent security cases, and authorizing detailed technical regulations by ordinance.
9f63ae7c1cd6a082aee59a9bbf5929b5b2e1b2f3: This section identifies the Federal Minister for Agriculture, Regions and Tourism and the Telecommunications Office subordinate to her as the telecommunications authorities.
9fdd7c5265948567094c7579b92469d94c0dc391: This section sets out the rules for how data controllers must communicate with individuals about their data protection rights and handle their requests, including required formats, response deadlines, when fees may be charged, identity verification, and the right to have restrictions reviewed by the data protection authority.
a0ca9d5c6f265b4b13b32b291f1f87fe5e271761: This section sets out when and under what conditions personal data may be processed for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, including the rules for using publicly available or pseudonymized data and the requirements for obtaining consent or approval from the data protection authority.
a0dafa78aa1b7019e080001183c38228ffe891ad: This section provides that the judicial member chairs the Telekom-Control Commission, that the Commission adopts its own rules of procedure and entrusts one member with managing ongoing affairs, and that valid decisions require unanimity with no abstentions, permitting deliberation and voting by circulation or telecommunications.
a15782190946d81367988c6e8beea86325a86a76: This section specifies how the head and deputy head of the Austrian Data Protection Authority are appointed, what qualifications they must have, who is barred from the role, and how they can be removed from office.
a395a28543c6bf421ca9aceb75b542d6655f95ba: This section establishes the principles for processing personal data, including lawfulness, purpose limitation, accuracy, and security, and sets specific rules for categorizing data subjects such as suspects, victims, and witnesses, distinguishing factual from evaluative data, and ensuring data quality when transmitting or sharing information.
a448adc7194da3f19e951a58bb76c898c0c1f19d: This section requires network operators to allow on-site inspections of their physical infrastructure within one month of a credible request from another operator planning a high-speed network expansion, outlines the limited circumstances under which such inspections may be refused, and provides for regulatory intervention if the parties cannot reach an agreement.
a4823647f79d9bd1098675058ddfde041213ef18: This section describes the conditions under which providers of public communication networks may obtain rights to install lines on publicly owned property, the compensation due to owners, and the procedure for resolving disputes.
a5815ab8d00e8ccf54e362de40340ea3ecd65738: This section states that the data controller must comply with the GDPR's accountability and data protection by design obligations to ensure processing aligns with this chapter of the law.
a6da44be5596852c45d6d9b6a3a5e407480375d5: This section sets out how the three-member Telekom-Control-Kommission is appointed and composed, who is barred from serving, how substitutes and vacancies are handled, and what remuneration members receive.
a72b2138a2a57f27c57853daeaa8c33d5f7f1abd: This section governs the creation and content of Austria's national frequency usage plan, covering the assignment of spectrum to radio services, limits on frequency allocations, procedures for alternative use of underused harmonized bands, and the conditions under which access to spectrum for communication networks and services must remain technology- and service-neutral.
a7d70af0a0bac61ef5e03d7cf8d5b3291f730278: This provision defines administrative offenses under Austrian data protection law punishable by fines up to €50,000, including unauthorized data access, unlawful disclosure of confidential data, fraudulent acquisition of personal data, illegal image processing, and refusal of inspection, and also covers attempts, fines against legal entities, confiscation of devices, and the competent authorities.
a7f15aa3280dc4cc4fa69c3bfffc819fa9bbcd83: This section requires telecom providers to give consumers (and small businesses or non-profits unless they waive the right) specific pre-contractual information and a standardized contract summary before a contract is concluded, and sets out the required format, timing, and legal effect of that information.
a9bfbeb935bf6731602165a763710743063e1750: This section defines the scope of the rules for processing personal and non-public data in public communications services and networks, and provides definitions for terms such as provider, user, traffic data, location data, and personal data breach.
aa1582b9701fc2dca05bb04da9417c8ba0724b65: This section covers the requirements for transmitting assigned call signs at the start, end, and during radio communications, as well as the rules for club stations using their own or a co-user's call sign.
aa9ff2f1a7ba970246fe0a667421890dc7d91f73: This provision covers complaints to the Federal Administrative Court by applying Section 27(1) by analogy while excluding Sections 27(2) through (4).
aaab636b6f86b18eba0f9406acf8e99bc9f5c113: This section sets out the rules for national regulatory authorities in different EU member states to coordinate and, where trade between member states is affected, refer cross-border disputes concerning the scope of Directive (EU) 2018/1972 (excluding radio frequency coordination) to BEREC for an opinion before taking action.
ad5191e4cb23f6e42667e94df6fbc6f8710a6e6c: This section states that anyone is entitled to provide communication networks or offer communication services as long as they comply with the legal provisions.
ad83b0038d98d08e34269c4bb2e1785c1f11b824: This section requires the regulatory authority to issue ordinances setting guideline rates for compensating the diminution in value of properties or objects under specified provisions, differentiated by infrastructure type and property characteristics, with regular review and prior consultation of interested parties.
ae28440ef1487651c5b4164d4c6ac00b9fcd661b: This provision establishes the Austrian Data Protection Authority as the national supervisory body for data protection, excludes oversight of courts acting in their judicial capacity, and applies GDPR rules on the authority's independence and organization.
aec39f4d434d622291e71436cd53b5b9a496b3b5: This section covers the rules for sharing in-building cabling with telecom providers and the regulator's authority to impose access obligations extending to the end-user connection point under certain market conditions.
b0fb1d8cf582c7ff1e1c82540b3e00dcd0cc7c2b: This section establishes the Data Protection Authority as the national supervisory authority under the GDPR and specifies that it is led by a Director who is replaced by a deputy in his absence.
b0fd44027486624fae9844829e16ed84f3ddea51: This section explains when telecom companies may let the public use their networks through local wireless networks (like Wi-Fi) inside customers' buildings, requiring the customer's consent and allowing others to add access points, while keeping existing EU internet and e-commerce rules in place.
b1d5524ca7f520f03f1343c643e52288f68e5283: This section empowers the regulator to require telecom companies with significant market power to grant other operators access to physical infrastructure such as buildings, in-building wiring, antennas, towers, poles, conduits, and distribution boxes.
b1f053eef4f977a3176ab8019b1bf229eec0d74f: This section sets out the rules for the frequency usage fee that holders of competitively allocated radio frequencies must pay, including how the minimum bid is set, when it can be adjusted based on market value, how the fee is specified in the allocation decision, and the deadline for payment.
b33bc6cf9f56effd670c3b82d3bce49be00683a8: This section explains the circumstances under which a frequency allocation expires or is revoked—such as waiver, time limits, death, insolvency, or breach of duties—and the procedures and notifications that follow.
b34aa4842668c9ccfaf312465bd99661f6b63be4: This section requires operators of public communication services to report security breaches involving personal or non-public data to the data protection authority and, where applicable, to affected individuals, and specifies related documentation, exceptions, and reporting duties.
b408b5e729bb73b6f8377050e09cfc0b4b424f29: This section covers the procedure for exercising usage rights over land for telecommunications, including the requirement to notify the landowner in writing, the effect of offering or paying compensation, and the option for either party to ask the regulatory authority to decide on the usage right or compensation if no agreement is reached within four weeks.
b434ec050d0bfde6fb9e41bd66abef472becca51: This section details the investigative, remedial, and advisory powers of the Austrian Data Protection Authority in cases involving law enforcement data processing under Directive (EU) 2016/680.
b50a1642ae8d4883c382f5bb954eac2db580b037: This section lists exceptions to the law's scope, excluding communications equipment used solely for national defense or by telecommunications authorities, and clarifying that trade regulations do not apply to telecom providers while competition law jurisdiction remains unaffected.
b55c0b1f1b397f13215c22b1f3b1e8c1e0941cef: This section lists the reasons authorization for building and operating radio installations and allocating frequencies must be refused, and allows a single authorization to cover multiple installations spread across an area that together provide area-wide telecommunications service.
b5e66e7c103371c1f3ba5d674b3163e0982e2c16: This section specifies that a company with significant market power operating solely on wholesale markets may face only limited regulatory obligations if it and its controlling entities have no retail activities in the EU, and requires the regulator to reassess those obligations if the conditions change or end-user competition problems emerge.
b628b72fa5ffa98dcf337140e27c9e4b6d99e4ef: This section sets out how amateur radio licenses are issued, covering their written form and certificate, the standard ten-year term and renewal procedure, assignment of call signs, license classes and power levels, and the minister's power to regulate certain stations, locations, and frequencies by ordinance.
b6677ac286645809b72c289c91285262c52fd4b1: This section covers the general prohibition on storing communication content data, permitting only legally authorized or technically necessary short-term storage and requiring immediate deletion once the data is no longer needed.
b6d28740c4044560c95a4fd371ea926beaac17c1: This section outlines the rules for when and how radio installations may be constructed and operated, covering the different types of permits required, exceptions for certain uses, and special provisions for government authorities and installations serving foreign territory.
bb8c926a46d3cba3dfb4ec7cfc42307b0f0ed3a4: This section empowers the regulator to require telecom companies with significant market power to grant competitors access to specific network components and associated facilities, detailing the types of access obligations that may be imposed and the factors to consider when setting them.
bc664ed9c8c17ed555c43132a4fb90f626479741: This section regulates the content of amateur radio messages in Austria, restricting them to technical tests, operational information, or trivial personal remarks and requiring that all communications occur only between licensed stations.
bc93751871566a4ba31c4f479c379fe3f1187603: This section requires telecom providers to offer end users a free annual block on chargeable third-party services (including premium-rate numbers over €0.20 per minute or per event) and allows providers to permanently block access if the user disputes charges in two consecutive billing periods.
bd1d462b1202ce9cf53d4c6aa5280d4a47b46b28: This section describes the coordination procedure for draft regulatory measures that affect trade between EU member states, including notification to the European Commission, BEREC, and other national regulators, mandatory waiting periods, and the handling of objections or withdrawal requests.
bdbb93604e22dfdb299c74687f9c937831ac821a: This section sets out when amateur radio license holders may allow others who have passed the amateur radio exam to use their station, the limits on such use based on the user's exam category and the station's license, possible exceptions for training purposes, and the license holder's continued responsibility for legal compliance and supervision.
c032d7380499189787e12dc6566745e71e4834bc: This article governs the meetings and decision-making procedures of the Data Protection Council, covering how meetings are called, who must attend, quorum and voting rules, committee formation, participation of non-voting officials and experts, and confidentiality duties.
c0e29f32e9b72cbbd54c6ce92bc85de9e22cc2d8: This section requires that applications for an amateur radio examination certificate be submitted in writing to the telecommunications office and include the applicant's name, address, and the desired examination category.
c2df051bd79e092b7ae4b3437c01a22b66915d11: This section outlines the confidentiality duties, right to refuse testimony, independence from instructions, appointment within federal ministries, and regular exchange of experience for data protection officers in the public sector.
c312da01fff363d8aaa16996347f9e44dee63d0f: This section sets out providers' duties to equip their networks for lawful communication surveillance and data requests, the rules for compensating 80% of the equipment costs, and the technical requirements for secure data transmission.
c39e39ceeb183e25b97b41dbbe5104b595924df0: This section establishes that data controllers are parties in proceedings before the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee, grants them the right to appeal to the Federal Administrative Court and the Administrative Court, and imposes statutory confidentiality obligations on the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee and the courts when they handle classified information.
c434abfd94aeede82cb4873105c8e912f79e3ae5: This section defines prohibited abusive uses of radio and terminal equipment and requires that such equipment be operated only for its authorized purpose, at approved locations, on assigned frequencies, without causing interference to public networks, and only connected to public networks if it meets regulatory compliance standards.
c58dfec461fbe11ac8f6375b2d7c076ed677df61: This section states that the aim is to efficiently structure and manage all communication parameters in order to meet the requirements of end users, providers, and operators in an open, objective, transparent, proportionate, and non-discriminatory way.
c693977773b006d527df05ff20c27a153fafd55a: This section covers the rights of individuals to have inaccurate personal data corrected or incomplete data completed, to have their data erased under specific conditions, and to have processing restricted in certain situations, as well as the obligations of data controllers to notify the individual, the relevant authority, and all recipients about any rectification, erasure, or restriction.
c6b931fdafafc850b1dabde3d3e1bc8de7ba3aeb: This section sets out the data security duties of public communication service operators, including GDPR-aligned security measures, user notifications for special confidentiality risks, and regulatory oversight.
c6e01d3f56aea4eed2da558d5b10e2eba6c29eef: This section sets out when public authorities and aid organizations may jointly process, share, or transfer personal data—including to foreign countries and to relatives—during a disaster to help affected persons and identify the missing or deceased, and requires deletion once the data is no longer needed.
c865b8559aab2e4fa3f44523499a97917311b1c3: This section requires the regulatory authority to offer end users a certified internet performance measurement mechanism that meets current technical standards, supports commonly used access technologies, and produces results that can serve as evidence in claims under EU open internet rules.
c88fbda6e2725d2fa9379984070c7e8d43b83655: This provision makes it a criminal offense, punishable by up to three months' imprisonment or a fine of up to 180 daily rates, for persons bound by telecommunications secrecy to unlawfully disclose the fact or content of communications or to falsify, alter, suppress, or withhold messages, and it requires that prosecution be initiated only upon the victim's complaint.
c9a6f2186a13a01a690fe2264c0cfc36245a1d03: This provision requires the regulatory authority to promote effective competition and prevent market distortions when granting, modifying, or renewing radio frequency assignments, and details the specific measures it may take—such as capping spectrum holdings, imposing access or roaming conditions, reserving spectrum for new entrants, or restricting transfers—along with the procedural rules and forward-looking market analysis guiding those decisions.
c9d1895da7a758c17e8d21aef8fb2bda09251dac: This section describes the mandatory notification to the Austrian regulatory authority that providers of public communication networks or services must make before starting, changing, or ending their operations, including the required information, the confirmation process, and related administrative steps.
c9d3ebe818c3019d5b532284d20416bf72f30a2a: This section outlines the rules for how the regulatory authority must protect trade secrets, determine what qualifies as one by balancing competing interests, and handle doubts about whether secrecy is justified.
c9ea37acb42db77226e5efd4f13732d6f71b2041: This section restricts how telecommunications operators may process, use, and share data from subscriber directories, limiting such use to purposes of number-based communication services and prohibiting profiling or categorization, while permitting certain disclosures subject to the same limits.
cc9e06e4d81dc6f3b5cb325859c78193e838cca8: This section outlines the obligations of data processors when processing personal data on behalf of a controller, including requirements for written contracts, restrictions on using sub-processors, specific duties regarding security and data subject rights, and the circumstances under which a processor is treated as a controller.
cd689ac13222cbbf15fd92a1d73a299b153a06ff: This section requires telecommunications providers and network operators to ensure free, uninterrupted access to the 112 emergency number and other emergency services—including text-based calls, caller identification, and location data—and to guarantee equal access for people with disabilities and roaming users.
cf1e6bca6aa38f2ff61d67f7d3ec64e462cb7534: This section regulates contract terms for telecom services provided to consumers and small businesses, covering maximum contract lengths, termination rights and fees, mandatory customer notifications about contract endings and tariff options, and rules for continuing service when customers relocate.
cf5d58e881f6237d130d3022e4c163254a5235c8: This section covers the rules for caller ID display and suppression in voice communication services, including the free options for callers and recipients to block or reject number display, its application to international calls, and the regulator's enforcement powers.
d0d13f05076c0d3f46ff6d7ec72f7000ed545669: This section outlines the independence rules for members of the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee, including prohibitions on outside activities that could compromise their impartiality, requirements to report and publicly disclose such activities, and limits on the National Council President's right to information about the committee's work.
