d192317977b0b0b1f16ca72bebfa36b9f0ecbe64: This section sets out rules for providers of number-based interpersonal communication services on maintaining user directories, operating telephone directory-assistance services, sharing directory data with other providers and publishers, and withholding user data from third parties when a user opts out of listing.
d257016c5c885e887129f363fedc9f058d38d036: This provision establishes the Data Protection Council at the Federal Ministry of Justice and outlines its duties to advise the federal government, issue recommendations and expert opinions, comment on draft legislation, request information from public authorities, and publish its observations, while excluding the internal affairs of recognized churches and religious societies from certain of these powers.
d39a3087ab64efe3cd0013118a6cb28a1d412e33: This section outlines the written notification procedure for commissioning certain radio installations, specifying the required information and how the authority addresses incomplete submissions.
d4c39f9598d1e412c052cf92b9b857289cd821a6: This section defines what the universal service covers, including affordable internet access with adequate bandwidth and voice communication services available to consumers and small businesses, along with the minimum bandwidth requirements for that internet access.
d553640fb63e8412024f34b8698ddaf31ae95e18: This section specifies that processing personal data is lawful only when mandated by law and necessary and proportionate for a competent authority to carry out its official tasks, except when required to protect a person's vital interests.
d7269b1c573692f195a37a529605d2f2011f9cfd: This section empowers the regulatory authority to order the immediate blocking of premium rate numbers when there are justified suspicions of violations of pricing information or proper use rules that could cause significant economic harm to users, and requires that blocking orders be published on the authority's website along with a maintained list of blocked numbers.
d820a65f61f2ec276b5d49a8e75faa1c4f167259: This section requires regulatory authorities to help maintain a uniform regulatory concept and obliges the regulatory authority to review its own ordinances and the practical effectiveness of contract summaries at least every three years, publishing the results on its website.
d863d6f9e40cea37d4ef491fc557ea7e3203b9de: This provision exempts micro-enterprises that offer only number-independent interpersonal communication services from most of the chapter's rules (except § 128) and requires them to give end users verifiable notice of this exemption before entering into a contract.
d939c66f61e5717348dcd8c0f1b0663e0c9d817f: This section outlines the consultation procedures requiring Austrian authorities to solicit and publish comments from interested parties on draft telecommunications measures with significant market impact, including minimum 30-day comment periods, suspended deadlines, notification to the Radio Spectrum Policy Group regarding harmonized frequency use, and separate consultation on end-user and consumer rights.
dafd8b527bd139ade96329105a70f2c412625613: This section states that references in this law to other federal laws are to be read as references to the version of those laws currently in force.
db8f21b8e14df62e8cd7ea2b5e9e6508bd39dca6: This section sets out the additional conditions for issuing amateur radio licenses, covering age and exam requirements for individuals, guardian consent for minors, licensing of clubs and public-interest organizations, and the reciprocal recognition and time limits for foreign license holders.
dd292487125a7c1b1d35d41c7fb33d45a2ab3b5a: This section designates the federal ministers and the President of the National Council responsible for implementing specific provisions of this data protection law.
ddf61695320b428ec47fba2e6837fdb2a3c8a3ef: This section sets out the transparency obligations the regulator can impose on dominant telecom companies regarding network access, including the specific information they must publish and the requirement to provide standard reference offers.
de8cb7b0715bef5bc2cea3ef4e6bde8bdd10ba10: This provision establishes which data protection rules apply to the processing of personal data by competent authorities for criminal investigations, public safety, national security, intelligence, and military purposes, and defines the key terms used throughout those rules.
df59645da205fcc2b75ce9be7843a411485cab56: This section sets out the regulator's duty to monitor end-user prices for universal services and its powers to require affordable tariffs, unbundled offerings, and prepayment options from designated providers when prices are unaffordable or bundling imposes unnecessary costs.
e066a5d1bb7fe3219be62240f1713f103b95be1a: This section covers the rules for ensuring universal telecommunications services are available, including how providers are selected through periodic market reviews and competitive tenders, and special procedures for individual locations.
e2daa6d4a911c82daa67a790dc64bf123bcf22bb: This section covers the prohibition of unsolicited advertising calls, faxes, emails, and text messages without prior consent, including exceptions for existing customers, caller identification rules, and where offenses committed abroad are treated as occurring.
e3bf081eb62165e7af81c1b7b5b376622cdaa7d7: This section covers the election, qualifications, disqualifications, removal, and compensation of the members of the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee.
e4d58316751ea565cef73d777722d39e9f4def34: This section requires owners of antenna masts and high-voltage power line masts to allow telecommunications providers, fire departments, rescue services, and security authorities to share use of the masts and necessary infrastructure when it is economically reasonable and technically feasible, with the co-user paying for minor required modifications.
e6868d117701ce048ee68597e1044979489f9a80: This section empowers the regulator to require telecom operators to share passive or active infrastructure or enter local roaming agreements when market-driven rollout is blocked by insurmountable obstacles and no fair alternatives exist, setting out the conditions, objectives, and periodic review requirements for such obligations.
e6adacd2fee767075b17bd4e23274b6f4a691262: This section requires data controllers to carry out a data protection impact assessment under the GDPR to safeguard the rights of data subjects and others affected, with the assessment documentation specifically required to show compliance with this part of the law.
e6adc7d427afbf2b693ae68dd91c29ff7f195209: This provision covers how data subjects can authorize a qualifying non-profit organization to file complaints and exercise their data protection rights on their behalf.
e72c8b802ddd72ea5ef0ba4fe5fd89c65a28ec48: This section lists the circumstances under which the telecommunications authority may prohibit the operation of a radio installation, such as missing notifications, unpaid fees, lack of authorization, or failure to remedy violations.
e776c4fac235a8b097f5244646b5abee10fc7d88: This section describes how the minister can grant time-limited exceptional permits for radio installations used for technical testing, the rules for assigning related frequencies (including required opinions from KommAustria or the regulatory authority for certain bands), and the conditions under which the Telecommunications Office may handle such applications instead.
e9fe78d7f0055fcb7c7a27250a721eb3a1ef100c: This part sets out rules for securing, logging, deleting, and labeling video surveillance data, and explains how individuals can find out who is responsible for a camera.
ea06488753445aabb1d1901434a461762b49a6ea: This section allows courts to order the publication of a criminal conviction in periodicals at the convicted person's expense when the offender has two prior convictions for similar offenses and is likely to reoffend.
eb11296a1f65c90389d380b0931c80aa12fe6801: This provision establishes the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee as Austria's national supervisory authority for data processing by the federal parliament, the Court of Audit, the Ombudsman Board, and certain supreme organs, and allows states to extend its oversight to state parliaments and related bodies.
eb240cd58dc7f8c94e3cf95c7e7a0e64c0e7de18: This section sets out the special rules and exemptions from data protection law that apply when personal data is processed for journalistic, scientific, artistic, or literary purposes in order to protect freedom of expression and information.
ec202f83b3680541af06e8276fc7e6c32130c269: This section sets out the rules for how long frequency assignments last, including maximum terms, conditions for extensions, requirements for long-term predictability for wireless broadband investments, and the process for renewing or reassigning frequencies when they expire.
ec5e4874c7ff3dbf08bb969da516734d063f0c23: This section specifies when a radio logbook must be maintained—during emergency or disaster radio traffic and exercises, or upon request by the telecommunications authority—and what must be recorded in it, including essential transmission details and, for emergency and disaster communications, the complete content with the identity and location of the other station.
ec8780a70d0ec069f7236b23f68a32c1b6b4f3af: This provision states that two or more controllers who jointly determine the purposes and means of processing are joint controllers and must set out in a transparent agreement their respective responsibilities for handling data subject rights and information duties, including a designated contact point for data subjects.
ece55253b312bce86288a67e7d244d61bb5ffe4e: This section allows the regulatory authority to exempt construction projects of minor value, scope, or duration from certain obligations, provided that interested parties are given a chance to comment and the European Commission is notified.
ef82f73c1d58db98b49eb2154f10192bb4035c76: This section defines the secrecy of communications as covering content, traffic, and location data (including unsuccessful connection attempts) and sets out who must keep such data confidential and when interception or disclosure is prohibited or permitted.
f2884992d1bf517f162b1d6564e56082fc1c57ac: This section assigns the Parliamentary Data Protection Committee authority over approvals for certain security-service data processing, defines its investigative powers and exceptions for official secrecy, and specifies the bodies to which it must submit its activity report.
f3f47dfdab7523f8422e3c3d4a205cce460014e1: This section sets out the rules for appeals to the Federal Administrative Court against decisions of telecommunications regulatory authorities, including that appeals do not automatically suspend the decision unless the court grants a stay to prevent severe and irreparable harm, and that cases involving the Telekom-Control-Kommission are decided by panels.
f43268e1f6a4cec29a3360aab2a7ab1ae0a0ec4c: This section requires telecommunications providers to transmit text-based public emergency warnings to end users on behalf of competent government authorities during major emergencies or disasters, and sets out rules on technical implementation, free reception, data processing, public logging by the regulator, and reimbursement of compliance costs.
f5152da687271259a02a1842fadabab24b558b2b: This section requires providers of internet and communication services to offer consumers tools to monitor and control usage, and allows the regulator to set spending caps and mandate additional safeguards such as warnings or service blocks to prevent unexpectedly high bills.
f61f8fa6804138507e77de15aba700d98c369228: This section requires owners or rights-holders of physical infrastructure to allow public communication network providers to co-use that infrastructure for expanding high-speed networks, provided it is economically reasonable and technically feasible.
f6602ea2dac69cdedcdd288fb981d45ce441eaad: This section governs network operators' right to obtain minimum information about planned construction projects on physical infrastructure for coordinating their own construction work, covering application procedures, time limits, exceptions for security and confidentiality, and dispute resolution.
f688fc2a513dca4d77eed6adef0b97beb0e777fb: This section authorizes the regulatory authority to issue regulations setting quality standards and advertising rules for internet access services, including requirements for reporting network information, while mandating coordination with KommAustria in certain cases.
f6f7b1a97d6c4e27037f55c87d12604d4b1e6182: This section describes the procedural steps and deadlines for dispute resolution before the regulatory authority for applications under sections 52 to 75, including the conciliation phase, deadlines for submitting evidence, the prohibition on amending the application, duties to cooperate, the six-week decision requirement, and expert cost rules.
f891f83b9facf224325aa65e0c59ad19a002ea1a: This section explains that the regulator may impose additional access obligations on companies with significant market power in exceptional circumstances, but only after the European Commission approves the request.
f8a8682ad0c1a81cfc30e8c7d93455e39343b35c: This section sets out how the national telecommunications regulator participates in EU procedures for cross-border markets, coordinates with other member states' regulators when market conditions are similar, and can jointly request BEREC to analyze cross-border end-user demand.
f8f356498ad300a3a21e2e6a3b81b2b953b9b27f: This section sets out when personal data gathered under this chapter can be processed for a different purpose or passed on to another party, including the need for specific legal authorization, informing recipients of any special conditions, and ensuring transfers to other EU countries or institutions are not subject to stricter rules than domestic ones.
fb9d97ac7166ed88fc88609056567a41690fecc4: This section covers the requirements for dominant telecom companies to notify the regulator at least three months before voluntarily separating their local access network assets into a separate entity, and the regulator's subsequent duty to reassess the relevant markets and adjust existing obligations accordingly.
fc43d7da21824972abd3407f041918b27f471c91: This section requires the regulatory authority to publish decisions of fundamental importance, market data, and other information that supports an open competitive market, while protecting personal data and business secrets.
fcd0a91748457f89bd80845dc5cc8292a8bf91d6: This section outlines the rules for imposing fines on legal persons such as companies for data protection violations, covering liability when senior personnel commit the breach or fail to supervise others, and states that public authorities and government bodies are exempt from such fines.
fd890b4162e007535f6e0e1ca94b481c0e4f375e: This section defines caller ID tracing (Fangschaltung) and requires providers to implement it or unmask suppressed numbers when an end user wants to track harassing calls, allows a reasonable fee, and mandates that the operator store and share the results for calls the user credibly reports as harassing.
fda49b5c66467aaa7f4aa73f27202b0725d36b2c: This section specifies the dates on which various provisions of the Telecommunications Act 2021 and its amendments enter into force or cease to apply.
fe1f87a83bc5b694165f85dfa6478d313ecf40c8: This section authorizes the regulatory authority to determine by ordinance the location of network termination points for public communication networks, taking into account BEREC guidelines and requiring coordination with the broadcasting regulator when broadcasting and telecommunications networks share the same physical infrastructure or when broadcasting is distributed over a telecommunications network.
ff6d9f51fc1ee6d4480b745b912c3f1ede668f7e: This section sets out the transparency and publication duties of telecom providers, requiring them to make their general terms and conditions and pricing information clear, comprehensive, machine-readable and accessible, and listing the specific service, quality, contract, fee, security, emergency-access and data-protection details those documents must contain.
